derivation.spec_heading: 7. Glyphs, Special Characters, and White-space Catalogs
derivation.reproducible: Re-running spec-derive-microtasks.py against an unchanged spec reproduces this contract with this same mt_id.

clause: Special-character and break/white-space catalogs: Studio MUST expose an insertable, deduped catalog of special characters, break characters, and white-space characters (provenance: InDesign/Illustrato [...] - enumeration (2)
spec_anchor_status: RESOLVED: derived from the assembled Master Spec module, not provisional

scope.summary: Special-character and break/white-space catalogs: Studio MUST expose an insertable, deduped catalog of special characters, break characters, and white-space characters (provenance: InDesign/Illustrator special-character and break menus). Break characters interact with the paragraph keep/flow model ([STU-TYP-037]) and threaded flow ([STU-TYP-005]). The normative catalog is: | Catalog | Members (non-exhaustive, deduped) | |---|---| | Symbols / special | Em dash, en dash, ellipsis, bullet, copyright, registered, trademark, section, paragraph mark, single/double typographer quotes, degree, discretionary hyphen, non-breaking hyphen | | Markers | Current page number, next/previous page number, section marker, footnote/endnote reference marker, anchored-object marker | | Break characters | Forced line break, column break, frame break, page break, odd-page break, even-page break, paragraph return | | White-space characters | Em space, en space, third/quarter/sixth space, thin space, hair space, figure space, punctuation space, flush space, non-breaking space (fixed and flexible width) |
scope.spec_text_is_authority: The clause text above is quoted from the Master Spec. Where this contract and the spec differ, the spec wins and this contract is regenerated.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: The enumeration accepts the member `Symbols / special` with the exact meaning the spec states: Em dash, en dash, ellipsis, bullet, copyright, registered, trademark, section, paragraph mark, single/double typographer quotes, degree, discretionary hyphen, non-breaking hyphen. No member is added, renamed, or silently mapped onto another.

The enumeration accepts the member `Markers` with the exact meaning the spec states: Current page number, next/previous page number, section marker, footnote/endnote reference marker, anchored-object marker. No member is added, renamed, or silently mapped onto another.

The enumeration accepts the member `Break characters` with the exact meaning the spec states: Forced line break, column break, frame break, page break, odd-page break, even-page break, paragraph return. No member is added, renamed, or silently mapped onto another.

The enumeration accepts the member `White-space characters` with the exact meaning the spec states: Em space, en space, third/quarter/sixth space, thin space, hair space, figure space, punctuation space, flush space, non-breaking space (fixed and flexible width). No member is added, renamed, or silently mapped onto another.

implementation_notes.naming: Vendor product names are provenance only. Studio ships Handshake-native names per [STU-SECTION-003].
implementation_notes.database: SurrealDB with the EventLedger is the only durable authority. SQLite, libSQL, Turso and PostgreSQL are forbidden, including in tests and dev caches.
implementation_notes.engine_split: GPU, WGSL and compute live in the studio-engine crate behind its traits. handshake_core must never gain a GPU dependency.
implementation_notes.routing: Navigation extends the existing address and bus seams. No new router.
